column1: # Reviewed source-before-caller placement where retail linker emission differs.

column4: Mac calls drawSmackerFrame at code0+0x25e788 from videoDrawCurrentFrame and retains its body at code0+0x25f948. Windows expands the canonical source call, requiring body visibility before the caller. Its out-of-line Windows body links later at 0x598e80, so this exact VA inversion reflects retained helper emission rather than a misplaced definition.

Windows and Mac both retain SavedGameHeader::reset and save as calls from game::save. The canonical ordinary bodies follow that caller in the shared TU so VC6 preserves the retail call boundaries; Windows links the helper emissions earlier at 0x4bc350/0x4bc5d0. Keep the source call shape and review this exact VA inversion.

Complete Mac SavedGameHeader constructor at 0xcf490 belongs before its reset/save/load and game::load cluster; Windows selection callers retain it while owning game::load/save expand it. The ordinary definition remains visible before those owning callers. Windows links its retained constructor at 0x4bc0e0 before setupShipyards 0x4bcb30; this exact inversion reflects cross-TU constructor emission, without changing the canonical body or its callers.

Mac retains updateBackpack at code0+0x136cb0 and getLastBackpackIndex at code0+0x136e7c before the scroll helpers and processIconSelect at code0+0x1370fc; the older DC body order independently agrees. Windows expands the canonical backpack helper calls and links their retained bodies later at 0x522470/0x5225d0. Preserve ordinary source-before-caller visibility and this exact deferred-emission inversion.
